atomic_operations.name: input_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Apply dropout to the encoder input representations before entering the first layer. This regularizes the model by randomly zeroing elements and scaling the survivors.

input_tensors.name: X_in
input_tensors.description: Input embeddings summed with positional encodings

hyperparameters.name: dropout_rate
hyperparameters.description: Dropout probability used across the model

atomic_operations.name: query_linear_matmul
atomic_operations.description: Matrix multiply to project hidden states to query space for all heads at once. Uses a single fused weight that packs per-head projections.

atomic_operations.name: query_linear_bias_add
atomic_operations.description: Add learnable bias to the query linear projection. This shifts each projected dimension.

atomic_operations.name: key_linear_matmul
atomic_operations.description: Project hidden states to key space for all heads using a packed weight matrix.

atomic_operations.name: key_linear_bias_add
atomic_operations.description: Add bias to the key linear projection.

atomic_operations.name: value_linear_matmul
atomic_operations.description: Project hidden states to value space for all heads using a packed weight matrix.

atomic_operations.name: value_linear_bias_add
atomic_operations.description: Add bias to the value linear projection.

atomic_operations.name: query_split_heads
atomic_operations.description: Reshape and permute queries to split d_model into num_heads heads with per-head dimension d_k, then move heads before sequence dimension.

atomic_operations.name: key_split_heads
atomic_operations.description: Reshape and permute keys into num_heads heads with dimension d_k, heads before seq.

atomic_operations.name: value_split_heads
atomic_operations.description: Reshape and permute values into num_heads heads with dimension d_v, heads before seq.

atomic_operations.name: attention_scores_matmul
atomic_operations.description: Compute raw attention scores for each head by multiplying queries with transposed keys across the last two dims.

atomic_operations.name: scale_attention_scores
atomic_operations.description: Scale the raw attention scores by 1/sqrt(d_k) to prevent softmax saturation, improving gradient flow.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: This scaling mitigates very large magnitudes before softmax.

atomic_operations.name: padding_mask_expand_broadcast
atomic_operations.description: Broadcast the boolean padding mask to match attention score shape so that padding tokens do not receive attention.

input_tensors.name: PadMask
input_tensors.description: True for real tokens, False for padding

output_tensors.name: M
output_tensors.description: Mask broadcast across heads and query positions

atomic_operations.name: apply_padding_mask
atomic_operations.description: Apply the padding mask by adding a large negative number to masked score positions so that after softmax they become near zero.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Use -inf if framework supports; otherwise -1e9 float.

atomic_operations.name: attention_softmax
atomic_operations.description: Normalize masked scores row-wise to obtain attention weights. Applies the log-sum-exp trick internally for stability.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Subtract max over keys before exponentiation: softmax(x) = softmax(x - max(x, dim=-1)).

atomic_operations.name: attention_weights_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Dropout on attention weights for regularization. Zeros some connections and rescales others during training.

hyperparameters.name: attn_dropout
hyperparameters.description: Dropout rate applied to attention weights

atomic_operations.name: attention_weighted_value_sum
atomic_operations.description: Multiply attention weights with per-head values to obtain context vectors for each query position.

atomic_operations.name: concat_attention_heads
atomic_operations.description: Transpose and reshape per-head contexts back to a single vector per position with dimension d_model.

atomic_operations.name: output_projection_matmul
atomic_operations.description: Project concatenated head outputs back to the model dimension using output projection matrix.

atomic_operations.name: output_projection_bias_add
atomic_operations.description: Add bias to the output projection of the attention block.

atomic_operations.name: attention_output_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Apply dropout to the attention sublayer output prior to residual addition, as used in the paper.

atomic_operations.name: residual_add_attention
atomic_operations.description: Add the sublayer output to the layer input to form a residual connection.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm1_mean
atomic_operations.description: Compute per-token mean across the feature dimension for the first LayerNorm.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm1_variance
atomic_operations.description: Compute per-token variance across features for the first LayerNorm.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm1_normalize
atomic_operations.description: Normalize residual sum using computed mean and variance with epsilon for numerical stability.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Use float32 accumulation in mixed precision.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm1_scale_shift
atomic_operations.description: Apply learned scale and shift to normalized activations for the first LayerNorm.

output_tensors.name: X_attn_norm
output_tensors.description: Output after Add & Norm of attention sublayer

atomic_operations.name: ffn_linear1_matmul
atomic_operations.description: First feed-forward linear transformation mapping model dimension to inner dimension for each position.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_linear1_bias_add
atomic_operations.description: Add bias to the first FFN linear transformation.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_relu_activation
atomic_operations.description: Apply ReLU activation elementwise to introduce non-linearity.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_hidden_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Optional dropout applied to the activated hidden FFN representation.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_linear2_matmul
atomic_operations.description: Second FFN linear transformation projecting back to model dimension.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_linear2_bias_add
atomic_operations.description: Add bias to the second FFN linear transformation.

atomic_operations.name: ffn_output_dropout
atomic_operations.description: Apply dropout to the FFN output before residual addition.

atomic_operations.name: residual_add_ffn
atomic_operations.description: Add the FFN output to the attention-normalized activations to complete the second residual connection.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm2_mean
atomic_operations.description: Compute per-token mean across features for the second LayerNorm.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm2_variance
atomic_operations.description: Compute per-token variance across features for the second LayerNorm.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm2_normalize
atomic_operations.description: Normalize the residual sum using the second LayerNorm statistics.
atomic_operations.numerical_stability_notes: Accumulate in float32/float64 in mixed precision.

atomic_operations.name: layernorm2_scale_shift
atomic_operations.description: Apply learned scale and shift to produce the layer output.

output_tensors.name: X_out
output_tensors.description: Final output of the encoder layer

data_flow.intermediate_result: Regularized inputs to the encoder stack
Linear query projection for all heads
data_flow.notes: Executed per layer l = 1..N with W_Q[l]
Encoder uses padding mask only (no causal mask)
Residual uses the same X that produced Q,K,V

data_flow.intermediate_result: FFN first linear with bias H

data_flow.notes: ReLU as in the original paper

data_flow.intermediate_result: Layer output X_out (input to next layer)
data_flow.notes: Repeat steps 2-38 for layers l=2..N using X_out as X

composite_operations.name: Scaled Dot-Product Attention (per head)
composite_operations.description: Core attention mechanism: compute scores QK^T, scale, mask, softmax, and weight values.
composite_operations.why_grouped: These steps are always executed together and can be fused into a single optimized kernel.

composite_operations.name: Multi-Head Self-Attention Sublayer
composite_operations.description: Projects inputs to Q, K, V for multiple heads, performs scaled dot-product attention in parallel, concatenates heads, and projects back.
composite_operations.why_grouped: This forms the first sublayer inside each encoder layer.

composite_operations.name: Add & LayerNorm after Attention
composite_operations.description: Residual addition of attention output and LayerNorm to stabilize optimization.
composite_operations.why_grouped: Matches 'Add & Norm' block in the figure.

composite_operations.name: Position-wise Feed-Forward Sublayer
composite_operations.description: Two linear layers with ReLU activation applied identically at each position.
composite_operations.why_grouped: This forms the second sublayer inside each encoder layer.

composite_operations.name: Add & LayerNorm after FFN
composite_operations.description: Residual addition of FFN output and LayerNorm to form the final layer output.
composite_operations.why_grouped: Matches 'Add & Norm' block in the figure and completes the layer.

composite_operations.name: Single Encoder Layer
composite_operations.description: One complete encoder layer: MHA sublayer with Add&Norm followed by FFN sublayer with Add&Norm.
composite_operations.why_grouped: This is the atomic repeat unit of the encoder stack.

composite_operations.name: Encoder Stack
composite_operations.description: Applies N identical encoder layers sequentially to transform input embeddings into contextual representations.
composite_operations.why_grouped: Represents the whole left stack labeled N× in Figure 1.

Prepare values for per-head weighted sum.
Merge head outputs back to model width.
Align padding mask with attention score tensor for masking.

special_cases.description: All dropout operations become identity; probabilities are not scaled.
special_cases.example: if not training: O_drop = O; Z_drop = Z

special_cases.description: Padding positions are masked out to avoid attending to pads. Mask must broadcast across heads and query length.
Accumulate in float32 to avoid overflow/underflow; cast back after.

implementation_hints.description: Construct a boolean padding mask from input ids where pad_id==0 (or similar), then broadcast to [B,1,1,S] and use masked_fill before softmax.
implementation_hints.code_snippet:
pad_mask = (input_ids != pad_id)  # [B,S]
M = pad_mask[:, None, None, :]  # [B,1,1,S]
scores = scores.masked_fill(~M, float('-inf'))

implementation_hints.description: For speed, compute Q, K, V with a single matmul and then split; many libraries expose linear(x, W_qkv) with W_qkv shape [d_model, 3*d_model].
implementation_hints.code_snippet:
qkv = X @ W_qkv + b_qkv  # [B,S,3*D]
Q, K, V = qkv.chunk(3, dim=-1)

implementation_hints.description: Prefer framework-fused scaled_dot_product_attention (Flash/MemEff kernels) which handle scaling, masking, softmax, and V matmul efficiently.
implementation_hints.code_snippet: C_h = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(Q_h, K_h, V_h, attn_mask=M, dropout_p=p if training else 0.0)

implementation_hints.description: Checkpoint inside each encoder layer (e.g., around attention and FFN blocks) to reduce memory at the cost of extra compute.
implementation_hints.code_snippet: out = torch.utils.checkpoint.checkpoint(lambda x: layer_forward(x, mask, training), x)

implementation_hints.description: Call contiguous() before view/reshape after transposes to avoid stride-related runtime errors.
Use epsilon=1e-6 as in the paper; accumulate in float32 in mixed precision.
